items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: I had a horror. You know, there were plenty of Negroes down here that played that style, Ted Lewis.

ctx.x: Couldn't have been anything which I would consider corny, like the early Ted Lewis or... Man, no siree. The Red Loom band or anything like that?
I had a horror. You know, there were plenty of Negroes down here that played that style, Ted Lewis. Plenty, plenty of Negroes, as a matter of fact.
Yeah, not that I'm trying to insult your taste, but I mean it was really Honest to Goodness, Good Band.
